results.title: Ohio State has been the most talented Big Ten football program of the decade
results.description: Talent-wise, you'd be hard-pressed to find a Big Ten program that has boasted more superstars, though. In fact, in a recent All-Decade team published by Diare Carragher of PFF, the Buckeyes were extremely well represented.

results.title: Pueblo County Football looking to build on winning culture entering new season
results.description: PUEBLO, Colo. (KRDO)-- Pueblo County football is getting used to winning. After a successful 2025 season that included a 7-4 record, victories over every Pueblo-area opponent and an undefeated record at home, the Hornets are determined to keep the momentum going. "Coming to this and actually winning, there's no better feeling," senior Brady Ware said. The post Pueblo County Football looking to build on winning culture entering new season appeared first on KRDO .
